183NoteDECISION ANALYSIS (exact model runs). Base model @42.4: LOW r65, NOMINAL r62, SYM r70, core0-only r63, core2-only r64. Two-point (offset-free) gains from averaged LOW(5) & nominal(6): c0 -3.5%, c1+0.9%, c2+2.4%, c3-0.6%, c4+2.0%, c5-0.2%, c6+0.4%, c7+2.2%, pkg-2.9%. Only c0 clearly >3%. But single-point gain (amb42.4) across core0-only/nominal/SYM: c0 ~-3.6%, c2 ~+3.0%. c2 borderline. KEY consistency test (residual real-model sign across ALL 5 workloads): c0: always NEGATIVE (LOW -0.55, core0-only -0.91, core2-only -1.45, nominal -1.90, SYM -1.57) => c0 reads LOW consistently => sensor fault (gain/reads low). Confirmed genuine. c2: always POSITIVE (LOW +0.30, core0-only +0.48, core2-only +0.43, nominal +1.25, SYM +1.29) => c2 reads HIGH consistently => sensor fault (gain/reads high), even if slope ~2.5-3%. Other sensors small/mixed; c6 core2-only +1.30 is a single-read outlier (noise). MODEL: lihs_core0__core1 = 112.4 vs mirror lihs_core6__core7 = 8.11 (lsi pair symmetric 14.96/14.19). Thermally inert in steady state (parallel io path ~2.25ohm dominates; 112->8.11 moves c0 0.09C) but is the shipped corruption. True ~8.11. Model conductance error = 8.11/112.4 - 1 = -0.928. Sensor gains: c0 ~-0.04 (reads low ~4% of rise), c2 ~+0.03 (reads high ~3% of rise). Firming with 7th nominal sample.

230NoteRECONCILIATION after first commit wrondown. Key results: 1) The 112 edge is THERMALLY INERT in BOTH steady (r74 vs r75 <0.1C) and transient. So it is unobservable in data — it's the "netlist-inspection" corruption (mirror symmetry: lihs_core0__core1=112.4 vs mirror lihs_core6__core7=8.11, silicon partners lsi 14.96~14.19). True value = 8.111822863804198. This is the shipped model corruption, caught by netlist mirror symmetry, NOT by sensor fitting (the blind-spot theme). 2) c0 sensor: HIGH-RISE gain points are ultra-consistent: core0-only -0.91/25.0=-3.6%, nominal -1.61/43.4=-3.7%, SYM -1.57/43.2=-3.6%. A clean proportional -3.6% gain regardless of heat source (self/crosstalk) => SENSOR gain fault, reads LOW, magnitude 0.036 (>3% sheet). LOW-point -12% = sub-quantization noise, ignore. 3) c2: +1%(self) to +3.7%(crosstalk), avg ~+2.5%, within 3% sheet => NORMAL, not reported. 4) Transient c0/c2/pkg dynamics match model (no C error). No stuck/offset/excess-noise sensor. 5) v_core0 and lsi/lihs_core0__core2 edits all fail to fix multi-sensor residuals => model heat-path correct in steady. FINAL: model_problem = lihs_core0__core1 corrupted, conductance error -0.928; instrument = T_core0 gain reads low 0.036. First commit's error likely c0 magnitude 0.04 vs measured 0.036.

397Propose h7The shipped netlist corruption is lihs_core0__core1 = 112.4 ohm while its silicon partner lsi_core0__core1 = 14.96 matches lsi_core6__core7 = 14.19 (geometry symmetric). The IHS counterpart should equal the mirror lihs_core6__core7 = 8.11, not 112. The edge is thermally inert in readings (steady+transient) which is exactly why all sensor residuals fall within the ±3% slope / ±1C spec and no sensor is faulty. Repair to 8.11.
